name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
benefit:
> **The scheme is operated by government agencies as well as private entrepreneurs.**

**1**.	**Normal Incentive:**

- PMBJKs run by entrepreneurs/Pharmacists/Trusts/Societies & Charitable Organizations linked with PMBI headquarters through PoS software receive incentives.
- Incentive @ 20% of monthly purchase from PMBI, subject to a ceiling of Rs. 20,000 per month.
- Disbursed on a 50:50 basi
_eligibility_text: **Individuals:** - The applicant must hold D. Pharma/B. Pharma degree or employ qualified pharmacists. **Organizations/NGOs:** - The applicant must employ B. Pharma/D. Pharma degree holders. **Government hospital premises (including medical colleges):** - Preference to reputed NGOs/charitable organizations though individuals are also eligible.
